name: Hanatsuka Aika
source: Kouhei and Riku's cousin. She chose to attend the same school as Kouhei and Riku, in addition to that she lives together with the siblings. She and Riku are much like sisters. She has a hidden hobby that is painting [spoiler](actually she's an otaku). In class, she's a a honor student so she's unable to reveal to anyone that she's an otaku.[/spoiler]
